persistentVolumeWritePreflight.finding: The check creates an exclusive private file in /var/lib/reach, writes and syncs 4096 bytes, and returns unwritable on a write or sync failure; it closes and removes the probe in finally.

persistentVolumeWritePreflight.limitation: No intentionally saturated persistent-volume ENOSPC simulation after the fix was recorded; do not claim that fault-injection case passed.

postFixFullVolumeEnospcInjection.reason: The operations evidence records a real 4096-byte write/fsync and volatile tmpfs rejection but no deliberate persistent-volume saturation after the fix.
